extracted.name: Quick Beef Stir-Fry
extracted.description: This beef stir-fry recipe is quick and easy for busy weeknights. Thin slices of beef sirloin are stir-fried with colorful vegetables and soy sauce.
ingredient_lines: 1 pound beef sirloin, cut into 2-inch strips
1 red bell pepper, cut into matchsticks
instruction_lines: Heat vegetable oil in a large wok or skillet over medium-high heat; add beef and stir-fry until browned, 3 to 4 minutes.
Move beef to the side of the wok and add broccoli, bell pepper, carrots, green onion, and garlic to the center of the wok; stir-fry vegetables for 2 minutes.
Stir beef into vegetables and season with soy sauce and sesame seeds. Continue to cook and stir until vegetables are tender, about 2 more minutes.
